title: Rubber plantation boundary dispute
description: Encroachment upon 5 cents of agricultural rubber land in Kottayam
preferredCourt: Munsiff Court / Sub Court, Kottayam (Appeals: District Court / High Court of Kerala)

aiTriage.summary: Dispute involves immovable landed property or title demarcation within Kottayam. Prima facie concerns ownership chain, boundary encroachment, or utility route compliance.
applicableActs: Kerala Land Reforms Act, 1963 (Tenancy rights and ceiling provisions)
Specific Relief Act, 1963 (Section 5, 6 for recovery of possession, Section 38 for Perpetual Injunction)
Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (Section 52 Lis Pendens, Section 54 Sale, Section 105 Lease)
Kerala Survey and Boundaries Act, 1961 (Section 9 & 10 demarcation)
Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (K-RERA) (if builder dispute)
Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 (Section 10/16 compensation if power grid/utility lines)
suggestedRemedies: Issue formal Statutory Legal Notice demanding immediate cessation of encroachment
File Original Suit (OS) for Permanent Prohibitory Injunction before Munsiff Court
Petition under Order XXVI Rule 9 CPC for Advocate Commissioner inspection with Taluk Surveyor to prepare Mahazar
Lodge Caveat Petition under Section 148A CPC before Sub Court / Munsiff Court to prevent ex-parte orders
aiTriage.estimatedCourtFee: ₹1,500 - ₹5,000 as per Section 27 / Schedule I of Kerala Court Fees and Suits Valuation Act, 1959
aiTriage.jurisdictionForum: Munsiff Court / Sub Court, Kottayam (Appeals: District Court / High Court of Kerala)
aiTriage.statutoryLimitation: 3 years from the date of threat or dispossession (Articles 64, 65, 58 of Limitation Act, 1963)

title: Arbitration dispute over software delivery contract
description: Vendor breached master services agreement; seeking urgent Section 9 interim relief
preferredCourt: High Court of Kerala Arbitration Centre / Commercial Court

aiTriage.summary: Arbitrable dispute involving contract interpretation, claim settlement, or arbitral tribunal proceedings in Kerala jurisdiction.
applicableActs: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (as amended in 2015, 2019, 2021)
Section 9 (Interim measures of protection by High Court / Commercial Court)
Section 11 (Appointment of Arbitrator by High Court of Kerala Arbitration Centre)
Section 34 (Setting aside of arbitral awards)
suggestedRemedies: Issue formal Notice of Arbitration under Section 21 invoking arbitration agreement and proposing sole arbitrator
File Section 9 Arbitration Request before High Court / Commercial Court for interim asset preservation
File Section 11(6) Application before Hon'ble High Court of Kerala if opposing party fails to agree on arbitrator
Apply for emergency interim injunction against encashment of performance bank guarantees

aiTriage.jurisdictionForum: High Court of Kerala Arbitration Centre / Commercial Court
aiTriage.statutoryLimitation: 3 years from accrual of dispute to invoke arbitration; 3 months for Section 34 challenge

title: Drawing 110kV Transmission Line Across Rubber Plantation Without Prior Notice
description: KSEB contractors entered agricultural property in Kanjirappally Village and initiated tree clearing for 110kV overhead line without serving mandatory notice under Section 10/16 of Telegraph Act.

aiTriage.summary: Violates procedural protections under Indian Telegraph Act 1885 and Kerala High Court ruling in Valsamma v. KSEB. Unilateral entry without District Magistrate order under Section 16 is actionable.
applicableActs: Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 (Section 10 & 16)
Electricity Act, 2003
Kerala Land Reforms Act, 1963
Article 226 of the Constitution of India
suggestedRemedies: File Urgent Writ Petition (Civil) seeking interim stay on tree felling
Serve legal notice to Executive Engineer, Transmission Division
Apply for District Court determination of land diminution and yield loss compensation
